missing_information_behavior: Identify the exact medication and vitamin K exposure; do not recommend starting, stopping or changing vitamin K without prescriber/pharmacist review.
safety_exclusions: Do not advise abrupt changes in vitamin K intake for people taking warfarin or other vitamin K antagonists.
Do not assume all anticoagulants interact identically with vitamin K.
Do not recommend vitamin K to reverse anticoagulation outside emergency medical care.
professional_escalation_conditions: Warfarin or another vitamin K antagonist, unstable INR, bleeding, thrombosis, planned procedure or unexplained bruising.
population_and_context: People already using vitamin K supplements and taking regular medicines; vitamin K can materially interact with vitamin K antagonist anticoagulants such as warfarin.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Maintain consistency of vitamin K intake and follow anticoagulation-clinic instructions; any change requires clinician oversight.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Vitamin K fact sheet describes clinically important interaction with warfarin and the need for consistent intake; drug-specific advice requires current product labeling and prescriber review.
